mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.75%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.75% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 240.0 signals accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of tight labor market conditions (UNRATE < 4.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals imminent recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), a federal funds rate above 0.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 240.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1000.0 signals strong housing market demand, correlating with positive economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000.0 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals manufacturing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 450000.0) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1000.0) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 450000.0 AND HOUST > 1000.0 and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals severe contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.
